title: Julia Morgan’s Redwood Grove

services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: Your experience begins with either a peaceful walk along the paved riverside path or a convenient shuttle ride to the estate. As you pass through the historic iron gate, adorned with a living wreath, and make your way down the driveway, you'll be welcomed into one of Northern California's most remarkable historic estates, where stories of architecture, history, and the people who shaped Benbow Valley come to life. Step back in time and experience the rich history of the Julia Morgan Redwood Grove on a guided tour led by our knowledgeable Estate Manager, Jenny, or owner Tanya. blurb: Nestled in the heart of Benbow Valley near Garberville, the Julia Morgan Redwood Grove is a private historic estate and premier redwood wedding venue in Humboldt County, California. Surrounded by towering old-growth Northern California redwoods and bordered by the South Fork of the Eel River, the property offers a serene, nature-immersed setting for weddings, private events, and overnight stays.
